title: Phones carry 1904 and its people with about 20 MB to spare
items: Nothing you can see changes. A phone used to hold a spare copy of every building picture inside the page, in case it had to load one again; it now hands that copy to the browser, which keeps it outside the page. 1904 on a phone takes about 20 MB less, so the Glessners, Martha Williamson and Mary Reynolds fit under the memory line with room left over. Desktops are unchanged.
